$comment: Failing fidelity cases, replayed on every run (phase-1.md 9.3). A 'regression' entry is a fixed bug and must pass; a 'known-failure' entry is a bug in the edit API that its owner has not fixed: it is replayed but does not fail the run, and the report says whether it still fails. A case is a function of source, seed and type (FIDELITY_CASE=<source>:<seed>:<type> replays it). Seeds are only stable while the generator and the family drawing code are unchanged, so an entry also keeps its reason.

cases.reason: Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a drawn minstart date lay outside the corpus plan's project frame (date_in_range). Dates are now drawn inside the frame.

Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a setAttr aimed at a statement written with a macro used a value that failed validation, so it was refused as invalid-value instead of text-only. The value is now valid for its attribute.
